version: V10 Core Optimized (same version number retained)
environment: Local Chromium via Playwright, headless Linux; static source inspection; tinycss2 CSS syntax parse; Node syntax check
scope: Footer and floating Back to Top behaviour
changes: Reframed the two secondary portraits as compact vertical editorial profile cards with captions rather than wide landscape crops.
Adjusted story layout proportions and tablet stacking to prevent squeezed copy and awkward blank spacing.
Replaced the footer Back to Top anchor that targeted the sticky header with a real button and explicit scroll handler.
Added a floating Back to Top control that appears after scrolling, is keyboard accessible, and is removed from tab order when hidden.
Blurred the activated top control before scrolling so keyboard focus cannot keep the footer region visually anchored.
Updated Back to Doors behaviour to return the visitor to the doors grid rather than leaving the viewport at the previous detail position.
Preserved the first-visit white + crimson theme and alternate dark theme.
Preserved V10 four-stage camera approach, hinged swing, portal push-in and skill detail reveal, plus reduced-motion fallback.

skill_doors.full_motion_sequence: approach zoom -> left-hinged swing -> portal push-in -> skill detail reveal

limitations: Tests were run in local headless Chromium, not on the user’s physical Windows/Android devices.
iOS Safari and Firefox have not been independently tested.
Live GitHub Pages deployment was not performed by the assistant.
No Lighthouse or PageSpeed score is claimed.
External Google Fonts delivery depends on network availability; system fallbacks remain configured.
